purpose: 본편 컷 자동 생성(Omni Flash · 초 단위 지시문)

items.name: c01
items.prompt:
Vertical 9:16 video, exactly 6 seconds, one continuous shot, no cuts. Handcrafted tabletop miniature diorama photography, tilt-shift shallow depth of field, warm soft practical light. The attached image is the FIRST FRAME: keep every object's shape, size, colour and position consistent with it. The main creature (whenever visible) keeps its exact anatomy and size.
The Venus flytrap anemone features a slender, textured, pale tan stalk that widens into a large, concave, funnel-shaped oral disc. The body has no segments, armour, head, tail, or eyes. The oral disc is pale pinkish-white on the inside and folds in half like a Venus flytrap. Its margins are fringed with numerous (dozens of) short, bright orange-pink tentacles arranged in two rows. The base attaches to a substrate via a small pedal disc. The exterior surface of the stalk and disc appears rough and fleshy, lacking any legs, arms, or fins.

TIMELINE
0.0-1.8s: A handcrafted miniature diorama shot on a wooden worktable, lit by a warm desk lamp. Strong tilt-shift, slightly high camera angle looking down. The Venus flytrap anemone figurine (pale tan stalk, large funnel-shaped oral disc with dozens of bright orange-pink tentacles) sits in the center against crumpled blue cellophane water. From the very first second, the anemone's oral disc rapidly folds in half like a trap, actively catching a piece of cotton-wool marine snow hanging on a fine thread. The upper quarter is calm and uncluttered. No text or real hands are visible. 1.8-4.0s: The camera slowly pushes in slightly while maintaining the miniature scale. The anemone's disc continues to press its halves firmly together, the bright orange-pink tentacles interlocking to secure the cotton-wool prey. The blue cellophane water background gently rustles. 4.0-6.0s: The camera holds steady. The anemone remains folded shut, its rough fleshy exterior visible, while other pieces of cotton-wool marine snow gently drift on their visible fine threads in the background. The upper quarter remains empty.
SOUND: none needed (it will be replaced). No music. No dialogue.
NEVER SHOW: text, letters, numbers, symbols, labels, logos, watermarks; real human hands, fingers or people; extra or different creatures; the main creature growing, shrinking or changing shape; morphing or melting objects; cuts, jump cuts or flicker.
